items.item: Blocker 2: 030351 opponent Darkrai = B2b 040 at t09/t11/t13/t15 and still at t03-t07; how opp_pick handles Stadium/Tool HP; any other opponent printing changed by the new rule in the 92 or the 125 Oct 12 positions
items.evidence: The ledger (BATCH_2026-10-13_NEWEST_TWO/20261013_030351000_iOS) writes every Darkrai as 'Bad Dreams / Dark Slumber 40; printed 100 HP'. It shows 100/100 up to turn 7 and 120/120 from turn 8, when the opponent played Starting Plains. In v3, opp.board is Darkrai B2b 040 at t03 (hp 100), t05 (100, F), t07 (100, FF), t09 (120, FFF), t11 (120, FFFF) and at t13/t15 (both copies, 120: FFFF+F and FFFF+FF). opp_ambiguous is []. v2 had B1 154 at t09-t15. How opp_pick works now: cardlib.hp_boost() reads the '+N HP' text of the Tool on the Pokemon and of the Stadium in play from the database. Only five cards carry such text: Giant Cape (any Pokemon +20), Leaf Cape ([G] +30), Elegant Cape (Stage 1 +30), Starting Plains (stage 0 +20) and Ancient Booster Energy Capsule (never applied). cardlib.HP.score gives 2 when printed HP + boost equals the shown HP, and 1 when printed HP equals the shown HP although a boost applied. opp_pick keeps the score-2 cards, else the score-1 cards, else all cards. It then narrows by any 'printed N HP' in the ledger text and ranks by attack/Ability titles. The Stadium comes from the row's board_at_start (030351 t09: Starting Plains). For Darkrai at 120: B2b 040 is 100+20 (score 2), B1 154 is 120 with a boost (score 1) and A2 109 scores 0, so B2b 040 is the pick, which the 'printed 100 HP' text confirms. Other printing changes: comparing every card id in hand, discard, board, behind and tools, main to v3 over all 92 positions, the only opponent change the HP rule causes is these Darkrai (1 at t09, 1 at t11, 2 at t13, 2 at t15). The other opponent changes have other causes: Tyrogue A4 101 added at 015011 t03 (Bench unwrap), Meowth B2 124 replacing Alolan Meowth A3 108 in 210823 (recorded correction), Elegant Cape B3b 065 replacing Giant Cape A2 147 in 022530 t03-t11 (correction), and Rare Candy removed from the opponent's discard at 015659 t05-t13 (correction). Oct 12 set: regenerating all 38 games with main's converter and with v3's gives 0 of 125 Oct 12 positions differing (JSON-equal), and all 24 Oct 12 deck files are unchanged. I also listed every Pokemon in all 217 positions' ledgers that has a boost Tool or sits under Starting Plains. They are: Mega Diancie ex, Suicune ex, Baxcalibur, Vespiquen ex, Scyther, Mega Scizor ex, Greavard, Houndstone, Finizen, Bulbasaur B1a 001, Ivysaur B1a 002, Mega Venusaur ex, Mega Sharpedo ex, Slowpoke, Igglybuff, Darkrai, and his own Druddigon, Axew, Haxorus and Dragonair. Each pick fits its ledger text; for example, Bulbasaur at 90 with Leaf Cape is the 60-HP B1a 001, as its 'printed 60' text says. Finally, I wrapped opp_pick across all 870 calls in the 217 positions: no pick contradicts the ledger's titles, and none contradicts a 'printed N HP' text.

new_findings.summary: Latent: in opp_pick, the new HP filter still overrules the ledger's own text. The 'printed N HP' filter and the title scoring both work only inside the HP-filtered set, so a ledger that wrote unboosted printed HP under a boost would get the wrong printing silently.
new_findings.evidence: rl/results/pause_games_new_2026-10-12/harness/ledger_to_positions.py, opp_pick (around lines 513-527): by_hp = score-2 cards, else score-1 cards, else all. Then 'by_hp = [i for i in by_hp if hp in printed] or by_hp' falls back to by_hp, and score_text ranks only within by_hp. Example: under Starting Plains, a ledger showing 'Shadow Cage; printed 120 HP' at hp_max 120 would still give B2b 040 (100+20 scores 2), which contradicts both the title and the printed-HP text, and with no opp_ambiguous entry. It has no effect on any current position: my wrapper over all 870 opp_pick calls in the 217 positions found 0 picks that contradict titles or printed-HP text. The same family of latent issue: evidence_texts() and his knocked-out cards (around line 928) pair a board_after HP with the board_at_start Stadium. No current turn changes a boost Stadium mid-turn on his side, so this also has no current effect.
new_findings.fix: Apply the 'printed N HP' text first, as a hard filter over all candidates, before the boost-based HP filter. When the HP filter would drop a candidate whose titles score higher, keep both and record them in opp_ambiguous rather than picking silently.

items.item: Major 2: Ilima turns 203719 t07, 210823 t08, 020824 t11 (Promote step, later slots, attack label)
items.evidence:
How the engine behaves: ilima_effect pushes one ReturnPokemonToHand per damaged [C] Pokémon. Here Regigigas is the only one each time, so pg_pos applies it by itself ('auto' step). apply_return_pokemon_to_hand empties slot 0 and calls trigger_promotion_or_declare_winner, which offers Promote{0,j} for each benched slot. Promote runs apply_activate, which swaps slot 0 with slot j and leaves slot j empty. Place is offered for every empty slot; forced_runs takes the first legal one, the lowest, which is the converter's place().

new_findings.evidence: rl/results/pause_games_new_2026-10-12/harness/kw_report.py norm() (lines 21-23, unchanged on the branch) strips only Ability and Place suffixes. In v3 km3_summary.json / km3_TABLES.md: 030351 t15 desc reads 'his [AttachTypedFromDiscard:Metal@0, Retreat:1, Attach:1Fighting@1 zone, Play:Iris] ↔ km3 [AttachTypedFromDiscard]'. 030351 t05 reads 'his [Ability, AttachTypedFromDiscard:Metal@0] ↔ km3 [Promote:0@1, FinishPokemonCheckup]', and km3's modal plan there contains 'Ability, AttachTypedFromDiscard'. new_findings.fix: Until the Rust label carries the type, have norm() map r'^AttachTypedFromDiscard(:.*)?$' to 'AttachTypedFromDiscard', or apply the same normalisation to both sides.

verdicts.id: Major 7 / scope item 5: Dragon's Blessing choice step (022530 t09; 030351 t05-t15) and what the harness does with it
verdicts.reason:

The plan step, re-derived from the raw ledgers:

- The ledgers' other Blessing plays are the opponent's (203719 opponent turns 4-20, 010003 opponent turns 4 and 6). None of them is in a plan. Across all 92 v3 positions the typed step appears in exactly these 7.
- 022530 t09: ledger play 4 is an ability, Fighting, destination 'Active Haxorus', nested 'Fighting selected at 414'. v3 his_plan has '...Ability, AttachTypedFromDiscard:Fighting@0, Attack:Frenzied Blade'.
- 030351: the ledger gives Metal each time, always onto the Active of that moment, and v3 has 'AttachTypedFromDiscard:Metal@0' every time:

  - t07: Haxorus-1;
  - t09: Druddigon-1, after Retreat:1;
  - t11: Druddigon-1, ledger order 3, before the Fighting attach at order 4, as in the plan;
  - t13: Druddigon-1;
  - t15: Haxorus-2, order 1, before the retreat.
- These match the engine (apply_abilities_action.rs 387-409): one AttachTypedFromDiscard{in_play_idx: 0, type, 1} per distinct type in his discard. The card text (B4 117) also says the Energy goes to the Active.

Not fixed: the label. pgd_patch.py line 47 (pg_label) and rl/strength/src/main.rs line 70 both reduce the choice to the bare 'AttachTypedFromDiscard'.
- 022530 t09: in all 12 seeds the legal list is ['AttachTypedFromDiscard','AttachTypedFromDiscard']. Metal is at the turn start and Rainbow Cave adds Fighting. The forced line is cut after Ability@2 and Frenzied Blade is still not replayed, so the review's stated consequence remains.
